posts.subject: Re:X-Rite Colour Assistant Unable To Download ICC Colour Profiles
posts.author: Hector_Lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hi Angelo1234!

Thank you for reaching out to the Lenovo Community. I understand you’d like to restore your factory color profile after a fresh Windows installation.

To try to restore your factory color profile after the fresh Windows install, follow this order:

1. Turn off HDR in Windows first.
Go to Settings > System > Display > HDR and make sure HDR is off.

2. Install all Lenovo updates before reinstalling X-Rite.
Open Lenovo Vantage and install all available updates, especially display, chipset, and related system updates. Restart the laptop after updates finish.

3. Remove X-Rite completely.
Go to Settings > Apps > Installed apps, uninstall X-Rite Color Assistant, then restart your device.

4. Reinstall X-Rite Color Assistant.
Install it again using the Lenovo-provided version for your device, then restart once more and test the app.

5. In X-Rite, try restoring the profile.
Open X-Rite Color Assistant and go to Settings > Restore profiles.

6. If the profile is still missing, run the profile recovery tool.
Browse to C:\Program Files (x86)\X-Rite Color Assistant\ and run ProfileUpdaterForDisplayReplacement.exe. Keep your laptop connected to the internet and follow the prompts.

7. If setup still fails, check for software conflict.
Make sure no other color calibration or display tuning software is installed, then try again after a clean boot.

Please share the model type that would look like 81C70000RK or 20UD000BUS from the sticker underneath, Vantage, or by typing sysinfo using Windows search so we can check the exact model and specifications.

We will be waiting for your response.

Best regards,
Hector_Lenovo
